title: A multimodal epilepsy dataset of paired 3-Tesla and 7-Tesla MRI and intracranial EEG (Penn 3T-7T, Pennsieve 662)
description: A multimodal dataset of paired 3-Tesla and 7-Tesla MRI (structural and resting-state fMRI) from 30 patients with drug-resistant focal epilepsy. For 15 of these patients it also provides curated ictal and interictal intracranial EEG epochs, together with electrode localizations in MNI space and atlas labels. fMRIPrep and FreeSurfer derivatives and iEEG-recon outputs are included. This is a BIDS redistribution of Pennsieve Discover dataset 662.
methods_description: Paired 3T and 7T MRI were acquired in patients with drug-resistant focal epilepsy. Intracranial EEG (ECoG grids/strips and/or SEEG depth electrodes) was sampled at 500, 512 or 1024 Hz. Ictal epochs were selected from epileptologist notes in the epilepsy monitoring unit. Interictal epochs were randomly selected during wakefulness, more than 72 h after implantation and at defined intervals from seizures. Electrodes were manually identified on post-implant CT and mapped to pre-implant MRI with iEEG-recon, with AAL, Lausanne and DKT atlas assignment.
